definitions.explanation: A very humble expression meaning "I have heard and understood" or "acknowledged." Used in formal business communication to confirm receipt or understanding of a message.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧、{拝承|はいしょう}⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I have duly noted your request.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧、{拝承|はいしょう}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have acknowledged the schedule change.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧、⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{拝承|はいしょう}⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I have duly understood the contents of your instructions.

notes:
Composed of {拝|はい} (humble prefix: to humbly do) + {承|しょう} (to receive, to hear). One of the most formal acknowledgment expressions in Japanese. Used almost exclusively in business correspondence and formal written communication.

REGISTER:
This is extremely formal and humble. In everyday business, ⟦{承知|しょうち}しました→承知する：01835_shouchisuru⟧ or ⟦{了解|りょうかい}しました→了解する：21992_ryoukaisuru⟧ are more typical. {拝承|はいしょう} signals maximum respect and deference.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧: understood, acknowledged — formal but less humble
- ⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧: understood, roger — common in business; less formal
- ⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧: consent, understanding — used when accepting a condition
- かしこまりました: understood (very polite) — a spoken equivalent in customer service
